checks.name: story compiles (schema + references)
no undefined jump targets
every dialogue node reachable
no dead ends (each node has -> end, a next or choices)
no dialogue traps (end reachable from every node)
choice nodes always offer an option (not all conditional)
flags read are set somewhere (no dead conditions)
flags set are read somewhere (consequences tracked)
declared mission flags are set
conditions and actions reference existing missions, characters, nodes and items
every mission can start (start action, next or start: auto)
every objective can complete
no mission dependency cycles
every mission belongs to an act
branches covered (a reachable choice sets each branch flag)
branches have consequences (flag read later)
branches fold back (foldback mission follows the branch)
every speaker is a defined character
main characters have want / need / flaw / arc
a protagonist is defined
speaking characters have a voice note
every defined character appears
lines ≤ 30 words, choices ≤ 12 words (brevity)
every mission offers a player choice
mission dialogue ≤ 60 lines (keep players playing)
every mission has a beat sheet
premise, themes and world facts stated
original IP (no known franchise names)
simulated playthroughs reach the ending (first, last, every branch)
every branch is playable to the ending
